result.instructions: Tools for Aryeo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still unpaid, and for which customers?"; "What shoots are scheduled this week and who is assigned to each?"; "Move tomorrow's 10am appointment to 2pm and tell the customer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Aryeo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aryeo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aryeo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aryeo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. aryeo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aryeo_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the orders of your Aryeo company (newest first by default), with payment status, fulfillment status, totals and links. Filter by search text (address or customer), payment/fulfillment status, appointment date range, tags or assigned users. GET /orders.

search.description: Orders whose address or customer matches this text, e.g. a street name.

payment_status.description: Only orders with this payment status.

fulfillment_status.description: Only orders with this fulfillment status.

appointment_start_after.description: Only orders with an appointment starting after this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

appointment_start_before.description: Only orders with an appointment starting before this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

creator_group_id.description: Only orders owned by this creator group (UUID).

tag_ids.description: Orders carrying any of these tag ids.

user_ids.description: Orders that have appointments with any of these user ids (user ids = company_user.id from aryeo_list_team_members, not the team member id).

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default -created_at.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: items, listing, customer, appointments, appointments.users, unconfirmed_appointments, order_form, discounts, discounts.coupon. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: customer, address, status, totals, payment and invoice links. Add include=items,appointments,listing,customer for the line items and visits. GET /orders/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: items, listing, customer, appointments, appointments.users, unconfirmed_appointments, order_form, discounts, discounts.coupon. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

tools.name: aryeo_update_order_notes
tools.title: Update order notes
tools.description: REPLACE the internal notes of an order (visible to your team only, not to the customer). The whole note is overwritten: read the order first and send the full new text. An empty string clears the notes. PUT /orders/{id}/notes.

internal_notes.description: The complete new internal notes (max 2550 characters) (replaces the old text).

tools.name: aryeo_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments (shoots/visits), by default the SCHEDULED ones, newest start first. Filter by upcoming/past, status, a start-time window or the assigned users. Use include=order,order.address,users to see where and who. GET /appointments.

tense.description: Only upcoming or only past appointments.

statuses.description: Appointment statuses to return (Aryeo default: SCHEDULED).

start_after.description: Only appointments starting at or after this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

start_before.description: Only appointments starting at or before this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

user_ids.description: Only appointments of these user ids (user ids = company_user.id from aryeo_list_team_members, not the team member id).

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default -start_at.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: owner, items, users, order, order.address, order.customer, order.customerGroup, order.listing, order.items, items.product_variant. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: One appointment by id: status, start/end, duration, assigned users and items. GET /appointments/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: owner, items, users, order, order.address, order.customer, order.listing, order.items, items.product_variant. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

tools.name: aryeo_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel appointment
tools.description: CANCEL an appointment. With notify=true Aryeo sends a cancellation notice to the order's customer (an email/message to a third party); with notify=false nobody is told. Cancelling can trigger fees or free the slot for other bookings. PUT /appointments/{id}/cancel.

notify.description: true = notify the order's customer of the cancellation; false = cancel silently. Required: decide explicitly.

tools.name: aryeo_reschedule_appointment
tools.title: Reschedule appointment
tools.description: MOVE an appointment to a new start and end time. With notify=true Aryeo sends a reschedule notice to the order's customer (a message to a third party). Check availability first (aryeo_list_available_timeslots). PUT /appointments/{id}/reschedule.

start_at.description: New start. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

end_at.description: New end. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

notify.description: true = notify the order's customer of the new time; false = move silently. Required: decide explicitly.

tools.name: aryeo_list_available_timeslots
tools.title: List available timeslots
tools.description: Bookable timeslots for ONE day (in the given timezone) for a proposed or existing appointment. Give either appointment_id, or duration + interval (minutes). Optionally restrict to users and tie it to an order. GET /scheduling/available-timeslots.

timezone.description: Timezone that defines the day (required by Aryeo), e.g. America/Chicago.

appointment_id.description: Existing appointment to find a new time for (UUID).

order_item_ids.description: Order item ids of the proposed appointment.

user_ids.description: Only slots where all of these users are free (user ids = company_user.id from aryeo_list_team_members, not the team member id).

duration.description: Appointment length in minutes (required without appointment_id).

interval.description: Slot start interval in minutes (required without appointment_id).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_available_dates
tools.title: List available dates
tools.description: Days that still have availability for a proposed or existing appointment: give a start/end range or a timeframe, plus either appointment_id or duration + interval (minutes). GET /scheduling/available-dates.

start_at.description: Availability after this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

end_at.description: Availability before this moment. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

timeframe.description: A named timeframe instead of start_at/end_at (see Aryeo docs: use page to move through weeks/months).

timezone.description: Client timezone (required by Aryeo); results are localized to it, e.g. America/Chicago.

appointment_id.description: Existing appointment to find a new date for (UUID).

order_item_ids.description: Order item ids of the proposed appointment.

user_ids.description: Only dates where all of these users are free (user ids = company_user.id from aryeo_list_team_members, not the team member id).

duration.description: Appointment length in minutes (required without appointment_id).

interval.description: Slot start interval in minutes (required without appointment_id).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List the property listings of your Aryeo company (address, status, price, bedrooms, delivery status, thumbnails). Filter by search text, address, listing agent, status, price/size ranges or delivery status. GET /listings.

search.description: Listings with a field matching this text.

address.description: Listings whose address matches, e.g. 123 Main St.

list_agent.description: Listings whose listing or co-listing agent matches, e.g. John Doe.

active.description: true = only listings with an active status (coming soon, for sale/lease, pending, sold, leased).

delivery_status.description: Only listings with this media delivery status.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default -created_at.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: list_agent, co_list_agent, images, files, videos, floor_plans, interactive_content, property_website, orders.appointments. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_get_listing
tools.title: Get listing
tools.description: One listing by id: address, status, price, lot/building details, agents. Add include=images,videos,orders.appointments for media and visits. GET /listings/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: list_agent, co_list_agent, images, files, videos, floor_plans, interactive_content, property_website, orders.appointments. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

tools.name: aryeo_get_listing_stats
tools.title: Get listing statistics
tools.description: Viewing statistics of a listing's property website (visits, views). GET /listings/{id}/stats.

tools.name: aryeo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List your customers (the agents, brokerages and teams who order from you) with contact details and balances. Filter by name, email, email domain, phone or search text. GET /customers.

email.description: Customers with this exact email address.

email_domain.description: Customers whose email is on this domain, e.g. gmail.com.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default -created_at.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Example: users. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer (an agent or brokerage that can place orders) in your Aryeo company from an owner name and email. Look the email up with aryeo_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. Aryeo may email the new customer an invitation. POST /customers.

owner_first_name.description: First name of the customer owner.

owner_last_name.description: Last name of the customer owner.

email.description: Email address of the customer owner.

office_name.description: Name of the office or brokerage.

tools.name: aryeo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List your services/products (main products and add-ons) with type, active state and variants. Inactive products are hidden unless include_inactive is true. GET /products.

search.description: Products with a field matching this text.

type.description: Only main products or only add-ons.

category_ids.description: Only products in these category ids.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default title.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_product_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List the product categories (use the ids to filter aryeo_list_products). GET /product-categories.

search.description: Categories with a field matching this text.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default title.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons (name, percent or amount off, active state, times redeemed). GET /coupons.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; a leading - sorts descending. Default -created_at.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Examples: promotion_codes, discountables. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_order_forms
tools.title: List order forms
tools.description: List your order forms (the public booking forms customers use), with title, URL and scheduling settings. GET /order-forms.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List your company's team members (photographers and staff) with role, status, service-provider flag and permissions. Each member has two ids: the member `id` (for aryeo_list_team_member_events and as the task assignee company_team_member_id) and `company_user.id` (the USER id, for the user_ids filters of orders, appointments, timeslots and dates). company_user is included by default. GET /company-team-members.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to expand. Default: company_user. Example: company_user. An unknown value makes Aryeo reply with the allowed list.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: aryeo_list_team_member_events
tools.title: List team member calendar
tools.description: A team member's calendar between two moments: appointments, blocks, external events and buffers. Use aryeo_list_team_members for the id. GET /company-team-members/{id}/events.

start.description: Start of the window. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the window. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

tools.name: aryeo_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (to-dos such as editing or delivery steps) with assignee, due date and completion state. GET /tasks.

tools.name: aryeo_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: aryeo_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task, optionally with a description, due date and an assignee (a company team member id). POST /tasks.

due_at.description: Due date. ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

company_team_member_id.description: Company team member to assign the task to (UUID).

tools.name: aryeo_complete_task
tools.title: Complete task
tools.description: Mark a task completed (now, or at the given time). PUT /tasks/{id}/complete.

completed_at.description: Completion time (default: now). ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Aryeo
prompts.description: What you can do with Aryeo here, with example requests to try.
